Class ImageCatalog

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.view.gui.ImageCatalog
public final class ImageCatalog extends Object
Central lookup for every PNG asset and the bundled Christmas Chalk font used by the GUI. Resolves IDs from server DTOs to the matching classpath resource under /assets/..., caches the resulting Image instances so repeated lookups don't re-decode from the jar.

      public static javafx.scene.image.Image cardFront(String id)
      Front asset for a card. Filename must equal the JSON id (e.g. "hunter_01"). Reads from cards_front_cropped/ — originals live in cards_front/ and are pre-processed by tools/preprocess_cards.sh.

    • cardBack

      public static javafx.scene.image.Image cardBack(CardType type, int era, boolean isFinal)
      Back asset matching a card's category and era. Buildings get the buildings-era back, final events get the end-game back, everyone else the normal era back. Cropped variants from cards_back_cropped/.
